title: duelframe
summary: MSUI implements current Benilla duel behavior through the shared two-slot StaticPopup coordinator and a dedicated DuelFrame law: asynchronous named challenge with ignore rejection, own-challenge auto-accept, explicit Accept/Decline/ESC replies, silent timeout/sweep, 10-second out-of-bounds warning dismissed by INBOUNDS, immediate then one-second system-chat countdown ticks, completion cancellation text and popup sweep, winner/retreat system lines, and the learned effect-83 spell path from UnitPopup Duel. Popup host size, text-line seats, and button seats are law-owned; focused and full interface-wire suites pass.

openItems.resolution: SMSG_DUEL_REQUESTED feeds the shared law-positioned DUEL_REQUESTED StaticPopup with Accept/Decline buttons, 60-second lifetime, hide-on-escape and igPlayerInvite entry sound; ignored challengers are declined without UI.

openItems.text: DUEL_OUTOFBOUNDS 10s forfeit-countdown popup with INBOUNDS hide
openItems.resolution: Bare OUTOFBOUNDS shows the text-only shared popup with the coordinator's 10-second clock and pluralized countdown; bare INBOUNDS hides it without a wire action.

openItems.text: Duel countdown and outcome system-chat lines
openItems.resolution: The milliseconds wire countdown is truncated to seconds and printed immediately then once per second through system chat; COMPLETE and WINNER produce the current cancellation/knockout/retreat lines.
Accept, explicit Decline/ESC, ignored-challenger rejection and the challenger's own auto-accept send byte-exact arbiter-GUID CMSG_DUEL_ACCEPTED/CANCELLED bodies.
